title: CraftersSpot Create
description: A Create mod based Minecraft server for all players to join, no whitelist whatsoever.
body:
The official CraftersSpot Studios Minecraft server, fully modded with the Create mod and its best addons along with other mods like furniture mods, Vista and more, all players are allowed, take a look at all the places you need, maybe stop by at DockerEats while you're out there!

[Notice: There are a lot of mods, make sure you have a somewhat good computer or laptop, the modpack includes Refurbished by MRCrayfish and other mods such as Create and more.]

[New notice: Starting from modpack update 1.9.0, server mods will be automatically installed by AutoModpack to save more time when downloading the server modpack itself, this will also provide easy mod updates when I add a new update to the server so you don't have to manually update the mods. The only times the modpack will receive updates are for optimization mods added by me for the client side.]
